summary: Implementation Design freezes a new visual-intent-graph-explorer slice with generic schema-driven root view discovery, two explicit explorer entrypoints, four critical architecture guardrails, and one supporting structural discovery test. Coding/Repair must now wire the VS Code command and runtime behavior so the frozen explicit entries can pass without changing their acceptance boundary.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Launch the extension host, resolve the structural root view from a schema-compliant graph, then invoke argo.openIntentGraphExplorer in test mode for an initial snapshot and an expand-path snapshot.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The returned snapshot initially exposes only the structural first-layer child views, and the expand-path snapshot reveals the selected child path.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: The explicit entry ran and failed on a readable real gap: VS Code command argo.openIntentGraphExplorer is not registered yet.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Launch the extension host, resolve the structural root view from a schema-compliant graph, then invoke argo.openIntentGraphExplorer in test mode with search queries by view name and included element name.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The returned snapshot exposes the matched target view and visible ancestor path for each search without mutating the graph file.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: The explicit entry shares the same first failing runtime gap as the drilldown entry: argo.openIntentGraphExplorer is not registered yet, so the suite cannot reach the frozen search assertions.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: visual-intent-graph-boundary
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Execute the standalone Node guard against src/visualIntentGraphEditor and its local contract.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The deep module directory, ARCHITECTURE.md, index.ts, openIntentGraphExplorer.ts, and the generic structural root discovery rule all exist and remain declared.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: visual-intent-graph-dependency-direction
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Execute the standalone Node guard that inspects imports in src/commands/intentGraphExplorer.ts and src/visualIntentGraphEditor/*.ts.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The command adapter only depends on ../visualIntentGraphEditor and the explorer module does not depend upward on commands, engine, or lm.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: intent-graph-explicit-entry-correctness
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Execute the standalone Node guard that checks both explorer explicit entries, both extension-host suites, and the command/explicit contracts.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Both explicit entries stay single, callable, contract-linked, and point to their intended support suites.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: visual-intent-graph-contract-traceability
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Execute the standalone Node guard that inspects OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md, src contracts, explorer contract, explicit contract, architecture contract, and package.json scripts.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The explorer slice remains traceable across contracts and executable scripts, including the Commands -> Visual Explorer dependency rule and explicit entry npm scripts.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: intent-graph-structural-discovery
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Execute the standalone Node support test against a schema-compliant design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The graph exposes one structural root view, at least one first-layer child view, and at least one searchable child view containing a named included element.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Explicit entry fails because argo.openIntentGraphExplorer is not registered in the extension runtime.
codingTargets.nextAction: Contribute and register the VS Code command, then route it through src/commands/intentGraphExplorer.ts into src/visualIntentGraphEditor without weakening the explicit entry assertions.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Even after command registration, the current module facade only throws a not-implemented error and returns no test-mode snapshot.
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement generic root view discovery, first-layer derivation, and expand-path snapshot generation based only on schema-compliant graph structure.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Search-expansion acceptance cannot pass until the explorer returns matchedViewIds and visible ancestor paths for view-name and element-name queries.
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement schema-driven search across view_name and included element names, then return the frozen test-mode snapshot fields consumed by the explicit search entry.

openGaps: package.json does not yet contribute a stable VS Code command named argo.openIntentGraphExplorer.
extension activation does not yet register the explorer runtime path.
src/visualIntentGraphEditor/openIntentGraphExplorer.ts still throws a not-implemented error instead of returning the frozen test-mode snapshot shape.

The explicit search entry was launched in this stage, but its runtime had not yet reached the suite assertion point by the time the handoff was written because VS Code test runtime extraction was still in progress; the frozen first failure remains the same missing command registration gap.
